branch_contact_value_shape.name: branch_contact_value_shape
branch_contact_value_shape.value:
case
            when "branch_contact"."role" in ('website','contact_page','appointment_url') then "branch_contact"."value" ~ '^https://'
            when "branch_contact"."role" = 'email' then "branch_contact"."value" ~ '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
            else "branch_contact"."value" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'
          end

branch_hours_shape.name: branch_hours_shape
branch_hours_shape.value: ("branch_hours"."is_24h" or "branch_hours"."is_closed") = ("branch_hours"."opens" is null and "branch_hours"."closes" is null)

branch_hours_effective.name: branch_hours_effective
branch_hours_effective.value: "branch_hours"."effective_to" is null or "branch_hours"."effective_from" is null or "branch_hours"."effective_to" >= "branch_hours"."effective_from"

branch_offering_specialty_uq.name: branch_offering_specialty_uq
branch_offering_specialty_uq.where: "branch_offering"."specialty_id" is not null and "branch_offering"."ended_at" is null

branch_offering_service_uq.name: branch_offering_service_uq
branch_offering_service_uq.where: "branch_offering"."service_id" is not null and "branch_offering"."ended_at" is null

branch_payer_dates.name: branch_payer_dates
branch_payer_dates.value: "branch_payer"."expires_on" is null or "branch_payer"."effective_from" is null or "branch_payer"."expires_on" > "branch_payer"."effective_from"

branch_price_range.name: branch_price_range
branch_price_range.value: "branch_price"."min_paise" is null or "branch_price"."max_paise" is null or "branch_price"."max_paise" >= "branch_price"."min_paise"

branch_price_effective.name: branch_price_effective
branch_price_effective.value: "branch_price"."effective_to" is null or "branch_price"."effective_from" is null or "branch_price"."effective_to" > "branch_price"."effective_from"

credential_dates.name: credential_dates
credential_dates.value: "credential"."expires_on" is null or "credential"."starts_on" is null or "credential"."expires_on" > "credential"."starts_on"

geography_code_uq.name: geography_code_uq
geography_code_uq.where: "geography"."external_code" is not null and "geography"."valid_to" is null

geography_validity.name: geography_validity
geography_validity.value: "geography"."valid_to" is null or "geography"."valid_from" is null or "geography"."valid_to" >= "geography"."valid_from"

hospital_branch_coords.name: hospital_branch_coords
hospital_branch_coords.value: ("hospital_branch"."lat" is null and "hospital_branch"."lng" is null) or ("hospital_branch"."lat" between 6 and 38 and "hospital_branch"."lng" between 68 and 98)

encounter_check_matched_needs_all_four.name: encounter_check_matched_needs_all_four
encounter_check_matched_needs_all_four.value: "restricted"."encounter_check"."outcome" <> 'matched' or ("restricted"."encounter_check"."document_kind_ok" and "restricted"."encounter_check"."branch_and_date_ok" and "restricted"."encounter_check"."patient_name_ok" and "restricted"."encounter_check"."account_link_ok" and "restricted"."encounter_check"."link_method" is not null)
